sources.snippet: Cosmos 3 connects understanding, generation, simulation, and action through a shared omnimodal world model that moves fluidly across text, images, video, audio, and actions.

sources.title: Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI
sources.snippet: We introduce Cosmos 3, a family of omnimodal world models designed to jointly process and generate language, image, video, audio, and action sequences within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. By supporting highly flexible input-output configurations, Cosmos 3 seamlessly unifies critical modalities for Physical AI -- effectively subsuming vision-language models, video generators ...
